integrity: The infinite result follows from an exact four-residue recurrence and a two-state base-4 extremal dynamic program. A standalone verifier independently compares direct prefix counting with the recurrence, checks quartic extrema and witnesses, and validates the state dynamic program on large finite ranges.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the normalized occurrence discrepancy of the factor 01 in the classical binary Thue-Morse word. It does not claim the same constants for other factors or automatic words, and it does not classify every index attaining an intermediate discrepancy value.
title: Sharp logarithmic discrepancy constants for Thue–Morse 01-occurrences
